ModMetaData.name: Genesis: Patches
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes and clean-up for the Genesis Mod Pack and its Combat Extended edition.
Fixes small conflicts between mods in the pack, hides the "Need research bench" alert until you have unlocked a research bench, and hides a few known, harmless startup errors from other mods while their authors work on fixes. Each hidden error is noted in the log as an info line instead, and every other error is left untouched.
